label: Reason for Leaving
options:
Resignation
End of fixed-term contract
Retirement
Dismissal
Death in service
Other
name: Employee Separation-custom_reason

label: Case Owner
description: Named HR Manager who handles it. Only they and HR Managers can read it.
name: Employee Grievance-custom_case_owner

label: No non-essential HR email
description: Skip HR reminders by email. Leave decisions and job offers are always sent.
name: User-custom_hr_email_opt_out

label: Receipt required above
description: Expense claim lines above this amount need a receipt. Leave empty to require a receipt on every line (set by ESWASA Finance).
name: HR Settings-custom_receipt_required_above

label: Receipt
description: File name of the receipt attached to the claim.
name: Expense Claim Detail-custom_receipt

label: Approval stage
description: Head of department, then HR (brief §12.1). Set by EswasaOne.
name: Job Requisition-custom_stage

label: Offer letter signatory
description: Who signs offer letters and certificates of service. Empty: the Executive Director.
name: HR Settings-custom_offer_signatory_role

label: Source
description: Direct: created by EswasaOne to onboard someone hired outside Recruitment.
name: Job Applicant-custom_source

label: Competence
description: The competence this training counts towards. Its results can back a Staff Authorisation (plan 07).
name: Training Event-custom_skill

label: External personnel enabled
description: Turn on to record external auditors and technical experts and authorise them like staff.
name: HR Settings-custom_external_personnel_enabled

label: Leave decision (working days)
description: Working days an approver has to decide a leave request before it goes to the HR Managers.
name: HR Settings-custom_leave_sla_days

label: Expense decision (working days)
description: Working days for an expense claim decision before the approver and Finance are reminded.
name: HR Settings-custom_expense_sla_days

label: Other HR decisions (working days)
description: Working days for requisitions, contract and lifecycle changes, access and profile requests.
name: HR Settings-custom_decision_sla_days

label: Head of department decision (days)
description: Days a head of department or the Executive Director has to decide authorisations and establishment changes.
name: HR Settings-custom_head_sla_days

label: Interview feedback (working days)
description: Working days after an interview for each panel member to record feedback.
name: HR Settings-custom_interview_feedback_days

label: Offer reply (working days)
description: Working days an offer waits for the candidate's answer before HR is reminded.
name: HR Settings-custom_offer_reply_days

label: Contract end alert (days)
description: HR and the line manager are alerted this many days before a contract ends.
name: HR Settings-custom_contract_notice_days

label: Probation review alert (days)
description: The line manager is asked for a probation outcome this many days before the confirmation date.
name: HR Settings-custom_probation_notice_days

label: Authorisation expiry alerts (days)
description: Comma-separated days before a staff authorisation expires when alerts go out, e.g. 60,30,7.
name: HR Settings-custom_expiry_alert_days

label: Thin cover (holders)
description: A competence with this many current holders or fewer is flagged to the head of department.
name: HR Settings-custom_thin_cover

label: Declaration hand-off (days)
description: Days an unsigned yearly declaration waits before HR is alerted.
name: HR Settings-custom_declaration_handoff_days

label: Movements window (days)
description: Joiners and leavers on the HR overview count over this many days.
name: HR Settings-custom_movement_days

label: Turnover window (days)
description: Turnover on the HR overview and Board pack counts over this many days.
name: HR Settings-custom_turnover_days

label: Appraisal cycle warning (days)
description: Unfinished appraisals show on the HR overview this many days before a cycle ends.
name: HR Settings-custom_cycle_warn_days

label: Appraisal reminders (working days)
description: Comma-separated working days before a cycle ends when reminders go out, e.g. 10,3.
name: HR Settings-custom_appraisal_reminder_days

label: Leave calendar span (days)
description: Longest period the leave calendar loads at once.
name: HR Settings-custom_calendar_max_days

label: Rating scale (top score)
description: Highest score on appraisal and interview ratings.
name: HR Settings-custom_rating_max

label: HR contact email
description: Shown to applicants and staff as the address for HR questions.
name: HR Settings-custom_hr_email

label: Owner
options:
HR
Line manager
New joiner
HR chooses
description: Who does it when the checklist starts: HR (whoever starts it), the line manager, the new joiner or leaver, or a person HR picks.
name: Employee Boarding Activity-custom_owner

label: Team
description: Shown next to the task, e.g. ICT or Finance.
name: Employee Boarding Activity-custom_team
